'''Hippiehog''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Cavyzap]] at 6 bronze stars/19 copies, and evolves into [[Wheekroller]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "The cage has been upgraded to a cozy home. Although usually only brave enough to peek through the door, Hippiehog will angrily (but quietly) let potential intruders know that they are not welcome."

Hippiehog is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Hippiehog's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Wheekroller]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Hippiehog to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Events#Marathon Party|Marathon Party]] (Use skateboard x2000) or [[Fishing Contest]] (Use Fishing Rod x2000).

== Trivia ==
* Hippiehog and its evolutions were added to the game on 8/12/2026 alongside [[Technocan]] and [[Blastniff]].
